previous_action: Following the recovery of the wounded, Gaius Maximus Valerius resumes his expedition and uses the extended pause to train with his troops, strengthening discipline and the bonds between the men and their commander.

continuity.campaign_development: The expedition has resumed after the spring fighting and the recovery of its wounded. Valerius used the pause to train personally with his men, strengthening discipline and cohesion. Scouts have resumed work in the countryside, and the forward holding remains the expedition's rear base with resident craftsmen and semi-permanent works.
